title: Korean cosmetics product catalog
price_method: Observed USD prices for the specified sizes and shades. U.S. prices are used where available; international import/reference prices are explicitly identified in price_basis. Regular prices are used when identifiable. Excludes tax, duties, shipping, subscriptions, and coupons. Known temporary discounts are omitted when a regular reference is shown. Prices and availability can change.
ingredients_method: Selected ingredients verified against linked product/formula sources. These are not complete INCI lists. Formulas and shade ingredients can change.
customer_fit_method: Customer descriptions are editorial inferences from product format, formula, and manufacturer-stated cosmetic benefits.
benefit_method: Summaries of intended cosmetic benefits, not guaranteed outcomes.
kpop_method: Dated official brand/company campaigns and statements. Brand-level associations do not establish endorsement of a specific SKU. Product-family links preserve shade, formula, and regional limits. Artist-reported personal use is distinguished from advertising. Current contracts are not inferred from past announcements. Null connections mean no sourced link has been added to this catalog.
availability_method: Availability is recorded only where the source explicitly shows it; Not assessed means stock was not checked. These are research reference products, not a live inventory feed.
